title: Packing List and Shipping Declaration
key_sentences: The goods listed below were packed on 1 June 2026 and are consigned in five packages for sea freight.
Packages are marked with the consignee code AMS-1180 and the package number.
Packages 1 and 5 must not be stacked more than two high.
I declare that the particulars given above are true and correct, that the goods are of United Kingdom origin and that they are not subject to any export licence requirement.
Please return a countersigned copy of this declaration to the shipper before the vessel sails.

rows: Kestrel Export Services Ltd, 40 Dock Road, Porthaven
Andes Mining Supplies S.A., Av. Industrial 1180, Callao
Safety helmets, white, packed 20 per carton

list_items.text: Goods are carried subject to the standard trading conditions of the forwarder, a copy of which is available on request.
Claims for damage must be notified in writing within seven days of delivery.
The shipper is responsible for the accuracy of the weights and dimensions stated.
Dangerous goods may not be included in any package without prior written agreement.
- Certificate of origin issued by the chamber of commerce
- Insurance certificate, cover 110% of invoice value

notes: Two-page packing list and shipping declaration (Roboto, Roboto Condensed in tables). The form block under the title is ONE table with four columns (label, value, label, value) and no header row; labels are form labels, not headings. The packing table is wide (8 columns), has cells of two lines (joined with one space; description column is top-aligned, numeric columns are bottom-aligned) and a total row whose first cell spans three columns (its text repeats in the three grid cells) and which has an empty cell in the Dimensions column. Page 2: declaration paragraph, a CSS-drawn decimal list of conditions in small type, a signature table with a header row and one filled row (its first cell, Signed, is empty), a container table (5 columns) and a TYPED hyphen list of attached documents ("- " kept in item text). Footer "PL-7731 · Page n of 2" per page; the letterhead lines are furniture. Names are fictional.
